answer_1.quote: Feedback comment generation is the task of generating explanatory notes for writing learning.

answer_4.quote: A professional annotator, who had English teaching experience for three years, manually evaluated the results.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator labeled each generated feedback comment as appropriate, partially appropriate, or inappropriate; partially appropriate refers to the case that a generation result would become appropriate if part of it were edited. Specifically, we set the following two conditions: (1) the type of error is correctly identified, and (2) replacing a few words makes it appropriate.
criteria: replaceable with few words to be appropriate
